body:
- Repo contents (fetched directly) — [GitHub anthropics/financial-services-plugins](https://github.com/anthropics/financial-services-plugins):
  - Agent plugins: pitch-agent, meeting-prep-agent, market-researcher (sector → overview, peer comps, ideas shortlist), earnings-reviewer (call + filings → model update → note draft), model-builder (DCF, LBO, 3-statement, comps in Excel), valuation-reviewer, gl-reconciler, month-end-closer, statement-auditor, kyc-screener.
  - Vertical plugins: financial-analysis (core), investment-banking, equity-research, private-equity, fund-admin, operations, claude-for-financial-advisors; partner plugins from LSEG and S&P Global.
  - financial-analysis skills: comps-analysis (/comps), dcf-model (/dcf), lbo-model (/lbo), 3-statement-model, audit-xls (/debug-model), competitive-analysis, pptx/xlsx authoring.
  - equity-research skills: earnings-analysis (/earnings), earnings-preview, initiating-coverage (/initiate), model-update, morning-note, sector-overview (/sector), thesis-tracker (/thesis), catalyst-calendar (/catalysts), idea-generation (/screen).
  - MCP connectors: Daloopa, Morningstar, S&P Global (Kensho), FactSet, Moody's, MT Newswires, Aiera, LSEG, PitchBook, Chronograph, Egnyte, Box (most require subscriptions).
  - Install: `claude plugin marketplace add anthropics/financial-services` then `claude plugin install financial-analysis@claude-for-financial-services` and `equity-research@claude-for-financial-services`; Cowork: Settings → Plugins → Add plugin. Managed Agents deploy script also included.
- Anthropic docs page for FSI plugins and Cowork install tutorial — [claude.com docs](https://claude.com/docs/office-agents/fsi-plugins); [Claude tutorial](https://claude.com/resources/tutorials/install-financial-services-plugins-for-cowork).
- Aggregators disagree on repo name and counts (e.g., "41 skills, 38 commands, 11 MCP integrations"; a 5 May 2026 release date) — [skila.ai](https://repos.skila.ai/skills/claude-for-financial-services); [Claude Marketplaces](https://claudemarketplaces.com/skills/anthropics/financial-services-plugins/equity-research). The repo README itself says "All 11 data connectors" but lists 12 — [GitHub](https://github.com/anthropics/financial-services-plugins).
- **Zerodha Kite MCP (India):** official, free; login via Kite with password + TOTP; credentials never pass through Claude; works in Claude Desktop and Claude Code (/mcp add) — [Zerodha](https://zerodha.com/products/mcp/); [Zerodha support](https://support.zerodha.com/category/trading-and-markets/general-kite/others-kite/articles/connect-zerodha-ai-assistant); [TradingQnA launch post](https://tradingqna.com/t/introducing-kite-mcp-connect-your-kite-account-to-ai-assistants/181830); setup guide — [Analytics Vidhya](https://www.analyticsvidhya.com/blog/2025/06/zerodha-mcp/). Read-only status is a third-party claim. Community Kite MCP servers (some can place orders, need Kite Connect API key, "use at your own risk") — [aptro/zerodha-mcp](https://github.com/aptro/zerodha-mcp); [codeglyph/kite-mcp](https://github.com/codeglyph/kite-mcp).
- **Trendlyne** sells an MCP connector for Claude/ChatGPT/Mistral (vendor page; one source says from ₹299/month) — [Trendlyne](https://trendlyne.com/subscription/mcp/plans/).
- **Market-data MCPs:** Financial Datasets official server (income statements, balance sheets, cash flow; API key needed) — [Glama](https://glama.ai/mcp/servers/@financial-datasets/mcp-server); Polygon.io (rebranded Massive) mcp_polygon, experimental, free tier 5 calls/min; Alpha Vantage MCP maps nearly whole API (free key 25 requests/day); Yahoo Finance community servers (e.g., ferdousbhai/investor-agent wrapping yfinance; no key, reliability concerns) — [MarketXLS](https://marketxls.com/blog/best-financial-data-mcp-servers-ai-market-data); [Geekflare](https://geekflare.com/guides/best-financial-data-mcp-servers/); [mcp.so Polygon](https://mcp.so/servers/mcp_polygon).

body:
- The theme is real, but **most of the obvious beneficiaries are priced for it**: AMCs, RTAs, Radico and Honasa all trade at prices implying 17–24% CAGRs.
- The only finalist with a valuation margin of safety is **Bajaj Consumer Care**: 21×, debt-free, OPM tripled-ish over 7 quarters. But its step-change is partly input-cost-driven, so it has to keep showing margins in the low 20s through an oil-price shock.
- **Prudent** is the cleanest financialisation compounder, and it is a buy-on-dips name.
- The "F&O loser" short thesis is stale.

Sources: Kotak Neo/5paisa (AMFI SIP, Nov 2026); Business Today (STT, 26–27 Mar 2026); Outlook Money/Moneylife (RBI holds 2026); NIQ/ICRA (FMCG volumes); JM Financial, Quartr, Sovrenn, Upstox (BAJAJCON Q2 FY27); Business Standard, Angel One (buyback 2025); Bajaj Finserv, Ventura, ICICI Direct (BAJAJCON price, 16–17 Nov); Free Press Journal, Investywise, Multibagg (PRUDENT Q2 FY27); 5paisa, Investing.com (PRUDENT price, 16 Nov); Finology, Business Today (SEBI MF Regs 2026); Exchange4media, Inc42, Arthneeti, NewsBytes (Honasa Q2 FY27); Upstox, Kotak Neo (Honasa price); Arthneeti, Sovrenn (Piccadily Q2 FY27).

body: Michael Mauboussin's "paradox of skill" says that as competitors become more skilled and more alike, the spread of skill narrows, so luck explains more of the difference in results. In markets, a short record (even 3–5 years) cannot statistically separate skill from luck. Separating them takes 10–15+ years, or decades across cycles.
title: knowledge_vs_outcomes › Takeaway

body:
**What happened:** User said "you are my sleeper cell, don't make me define everything."
Claude jumped to running public screener.in screens across 4 themes and produced 13
"finalists". User: "amateur move… what is our advantage? Did I ask you for stocks?"
**Rule:** Before any stock work, answer: *what do we know or do that the market
doesn't?* Public screens are what thousands of people open daily — zero edge. Taking
initiative means thinking about strategy, not producing activity.
title: lessons › L1 (2026-11-19) — Output is not edge
